description: This file defines the 'Module' class within the OpenCart admin model for setting modules. It provides methods for adding, editing, deleting, and fetching module data from the database, including operations by module ID and code.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents the module management model in the OpenCart admin setting context, providing CRUD operations for modules stored in the database.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Creates a new module record in the database with the specified code and data.

methods.name: editModule
methods.description: Updates an existing module record identified by module_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteModule
methods.description: Deletes the module record identified by module_id from the database.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes all modules with a specific code and associated layout modules.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves a module record by its module_id, returning its settings as an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves all module records ordered by code.

methods.name: getModulesByCode
methods.description: Retrieves all modules with a specific code, ordered by name.
